report: CompliVibe — Complete Site SEO & Redesign Pass
positioning: AI Trust Infrastructure / AI Trust OS
finalVerdict: Site was ~90% already redesigned with metadata. This was a focused technical-SEO + correctness finishing pass. The 4 legal pages (the last old dark pages) were rebuilt light-first; all broken OG image refs, duplicate next.config, fake SearchAction, a fake-success form, and stale positioning were fixed. build + lint + typecheck all pass.
